landing.heroTitle: Previously Unpublished Books, Now at Your Fingertips
landing.heroSubtitle: Discover rare manuscripts and authentic readings in a focused experience built for serious readers and researchers.
landing.section.finalCta: Start Your Journey with Rare Texts
landing.finalText: Build your private library from books that never got their publishing spotlight.
landing.values.rare.title: Rare Discovery
landing.values.rare.description: Manuscripts and hard-to-find books organized so you can reach what matters faster.
landing.values.focused.title: Focused Reading
landing.values.focused.description: A calm reading interface with in-book search and precise page navigation.
landing.values.organized.title: Structured Knowledge
landing.values.organized.description: Categories, authors, and alternative titles help you build a cohesive research library.
landing.spotlight.title: The Moroccan Journey in Describing Libraries of Knowledge
landing.spotlight.description: A travel narrative tracing how books moved between historic cities, revealing titles absent from modern publishing.
landing.journey.step1.title: Build Your Library
landing.journey.step1.text: Upload the book with core metadata and it enters indexing immediately.
landing.journey.step2.title: Open the Text
landing.journey.step2.text: Move between pages, add notes, and save important passages for quick return.
landing.journey.step3.title: Extract Value
landing.journey.step3.text: Search inside content and document findings with clearer insight into the text.
landing.categories.description: Start from the field you care about, then branch into related titles that surface texts missing from traditional libraries.
landing.testimonials.item1.quote: For the first time, I can read manuscripts unavailable in commercial publishing through a genuinely smooth digital experience.
landing.testimonials.item1.author: Heritage Researcher - Riyadh
landing.testimonials.item2.quote: Organized notes with in-text search saved me hours during academic preparation.
landing.testimonials.item2.author: Graduate Student - Cairo
landing.testimonials.item3.quote: The Arabic-first interface and right-to-left flow make reading feel natural and distraction-free.
